dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Remus was surrendered to the care center as a stray after spending three days in the home with his finder, so we have only limited history on his behavior in a home environment. His finder describes Remus as an affectionate dog who can be a couch potato. During his time at the care center, he has shown highly fearful behavior, including hard barking and growling at staff; his finder reports that they also observed this behavior with strangers. With known handlers, Remus displays social and affiliative behavior, but will revert to fearfulness around unfamiliar people. Due to these concerns, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can allow for decompression, provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based), and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
